remarks: Welcome home to this bright, sun-filled end unit with an eat-in kitchen. Enjoy your deck off of the spacious living room as well as a patio off of the dining room. With over 1,050 square feet there is plenty of storage space. The primary bedroom suite is fully carpeted and complete with three closets and laundry on the second floor. The dining and living rooms have hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace for those cool winter weekends. Enjoy top of the line home automation with the Philips Hue Lighting system, Google SmartHome Security System and Nest thermostats! You will be just minutes away from Ridgway Shopping Center and bus lines. There is plenty of guest parking and two swimming pools. This complex is beautifully maintained by a management company that is very responsive. A lovely place to live.
